items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...music recorded at the Stuyvesant Casino with Henry Red Allen, Eddie Price and Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: And I intend to tape this and some day maybe I will -- since everybody else is taping to make albums, I think I'll tape some of this and make my own album. What can they do to me? What can they do to those guys? I couldn't do anything with these guys for the Pocket labels, you know.
